notes.title: Small update to version 0.4.1
notes.content:
Small update to version 0.4.1 

Changelog:

1) It's now possible to turn the visibility of the In-Game-Timer on or off. Under "Options --> AUDIO / GAME" Settings. The time is still running in the background though for achievements.

2) "Select Game" option was removed to have faster access to the game.

notes.title: Update to EA Build 0.3.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

while still working on the second game mode for [b]Vole Complexity[/b], we decided to make some changes for a few assets / textures and graphics of the game. 
With this update the first 10 floors for the first skill level will get a slightly new look. We hope you will like it. 
Updates for the floors 11-30 for skill level 2 and 3 will come next year. 

This will be probably the last update for this year, so we already wish you all happy holidays, merry christmas and a happy new year.

Your team from
makingArts Entertainment
